name: es-runtime-repo
description: The workspace root. The runtime itself is Rust; tasks are in tasks.toml.
_workspaces: website/ and bench/ are deliberately not members and keep their own bun.lock. Every lockfile here is version 1, which is all website/'s deploy can read: a canary bun writes 2 into a lockfile it creates from scratch, though it leaves an existing 1 alone — so `packageManager` names a released bun, and a regenerated lockfile has to come from one. bench/ is the cross-runtime comparison clients, which have no business in the runtime's dependency graph.
